selection.summary: PR fixes #1971 by adding `.` support to `gh repo view` for viewing the current branch's README (remote if available, else local file), with a description noting the README source. Relevant base evidence: repo view command implementation (view.go) including Readme display logic and command setup (h0, h3), README fetching over HTTP (h1, h16, h17), and existing view tests covering output and README rendering (h2, h11-h13).
